method.description: Curated exact-ID test/output pairs, ranked within each condition label.

plot_settings.description: Duration-adaptive Hann windows and species-aware frequency axes, identical within each real/generated pair. Settings recorded per selected pair. No image smoothing or interpolation.
plot_settings.reference: Joint peak STFT amplitude across the two exported playback clips
